messages:
Emily: Quick check — prepping a canary for a per-client flag tied to contract ACME-2026 to enable enterprise_search_v2. Need an ops + gating plan, owners for allowlist provisioning, and a short rollback policy. cc @Ben @Carla
Ben: I can own allowlist provisioning. One question: do we gate at org level or account level? Contract text references org IDs.
Carla: org-level makes sense. We'll map contract.entitlements -> allowlist by org external_id. Need admin UI toggle and audit log entries. How many clients for the initial canary?
Emily: Start conservative: 3 clients (acme, nimbus, orbit) — mark them as VIP canary group. 48h window. Telemetry thresholds: error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency up > 30% => rollback. Also require manual validation of results after 24h.
Alice: I'll add the telemetry checks and a dashboard tile in Console. Also will add a kill-switch endpoint: POST /admin/features/enterprise_search_v2/kill (restricted to SRE/admins).
Dave: For the implementation, reuse the contract-gating middleware. Proposed flag payload for ops config: ```
{
  "flag": "enterprise_search_v2",
  "scope": "org",
  "allowlist": ["acme:org-123", "nimbus:org-999", "orbit:org-555"],
  "contractId": "ACME-2026",
  "rollback_conditions": { "error_rate_pct": 0.5, "p95_latency_increase_pct": 30 }
}
```
Carla: infra-bot, please provision staging allowlist entries and a staging flag so QA can validate. Also add an e2e test to confirm fallback to legacy search when entitlement missing.
infra-bot: Provisioned staging allowlist entries: acme:org-123, nimbus:org-999, orbit:org-555. Staging flag created: feature.enterprise_search_v2.staging. Pipeline build #452 queued: <https://ci.internal/jobs/452>.
Carla: We'll need a CR for the flag gating changes and an e2e test that covers contract mismatch -> fallback behavior to legacy search. Pinging reviewers @Ben @Alice.
Ben: I'll review the CR today. Note: we should explicitly document rate-limit exceptions for VIPs in the rollout doc.
Emily: Added a task ENG-FF-812 on the engineering board with rollout steps, owners, and rollback checklist. Rollout expiration (auto-remove allowlist) set to 7 days if not promoted.
Alice: Also ensure we log entitlement source (contract vs admin-provisioned) in the audit events to satisfy compliance checks.
Dave: Merging middleware patch momentarily. For the canary we will toggle env var FEATURE_ENTERPRISE_SEARCH_V2=true and use per-client knob ENABLE_FLAG_ACME=true to enable only acme in prod initially.
Emily: Cool — schedule canary flip at Thu 10:00 PT. If we hit rollback conditions, SRE will flip kill-switch and open a postmortem. I have a postmortem template ready.
Ben: :thumbsup: Any blockers before Thurs?
Carla: QA needs the staging flag and e2e tests green. infra-bot confirms pipeline queued.
Emily: Thanks all — I'll update the shared doc and ping again when we're ready to flip.
